title: Simulated Gamma-Ray Burst Event Dataset A1

citation.text: Koexai S.r.l. (2025). Simulated Gamma-Ray Burst Event Dataset A1 (Version 1.0.0). KOEXAI-GRB-A1-v1.0

abstract: This dataset contains simulated gamma-ray burst (GRB) event data generated for astrophysical research and analysis. The dataset comprises 100 HDF5 files containing approximately 171,558 individual gamma-ray detection events from simulated GRB sources. Each event includes reconstructed energy, celestial coordinates, angular parameters, timing information, and Monte Carlo truth data. The simulations represent filtered event data from gamma-ray detectors, suitable for developing and testing analysis pipelines for high-energy astrophysics research.
purpose: This dataset is intended for developing and validating analysis methods for gamma-ray burst detection and characterization, training machine learning models for event classification, and testing data processing pipelines for high-energy astrophysics experiments.

provenance.sources: Monte Carlo simulations of gamma-ray burst events using standard astrophysical simulation frameworks
provenance.processing: Events were generated through Monte Carlo simulations, then filtered based on quality criteria including reconstruction quality, angular separation, and energy thresholds. The filtering process removed low-quality events and retained high-confidence detections suitable for scientific analysis.
provenance.derivations: Derived quantities include reconstructed energy (ENERGY), angular positions (RA, DEC), and event weights (WEIGHT) calculated from Monte Carlo truth information. Containment angle (CONT_ANG) represents the angular separation between reconstructed and true positions.

structure.encoding: Binary HDF5 format with PyTables structure
structure.conventions: Times are in MET (Mission Elapsed Time) format as float64 Unix timestamps. Missing or invalid events are indicated by empty HDF5 groups. Coordinate systems: RA/DEC in degrees (J2000), Galactic coordinates L/B in degrees, angles in degrees.
structure.relationships: Each HDF5 file represents events from a single simulated GRB source. Files are independent and can be processed separately. The 'GRB' column provides the source identifier linking events to their parent simulation.
structure.fileNamingConvention: GRB_Simulated_<ID>_filtered.hdf5, where ID is a unique numeric identifier

quality.validation: Events underwent automated quality filtering based on reconstruction parameters. Files with no events passing quality cuts were retained as empty placeholders. Data integrity verified through HDF5 file validation and statistical checks on key parameters.
limitations: Some simulated GRBs produced no events passing quality filters, resulting in 9 empty files
Event statistics vary significantly between simulations due to different source parameters and observing conditions
Simulated data may not fully capture all systematic uncertainties present in real observations
Coordinate precision limited by reconstruction algorithms used in simulation
No instrumental background events are included in this filtered dataset
quality.usageGuidance: This dataset is recommended for algorithm development, pipeline testing, and machine learning training. It should not be used for direct comparison with real observational data without accounting for differences in background, systematic effects, and detector response. Files with few events (<10) should be treated with caution for statistical analyses.

access.reuseGuidance: Users must cite this dataset when using it in publications or derivative works. Commercial use is permitted. Modified versions should clearly indicate changes from the original dataset.

dataTypes.ZENITH_ANGLE: Zenith angle of observation in degrees
dataTypes.TIME: Event time in Mission Elapsed Time (MET) seconds
dataTypes.MCENERGY: True (Monte Carlo) photon energy in GeV
dataTypes.CONT_ANG: Containment angle between reconstructed and true position in degrees
